# komodo_alerter (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo alerter by ID or name. The endpoint URL is not exposed, since it usually embeds a token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "komodo_alerter" "discord" {
  id = "discord" # ID or alerter name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Alerter ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `alert_types` (List of String) Alert types the alerter is limited to. Empty means all types.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alerter sends alerts.
- `endpoint_type` (String) Endpoint type: Custom, Slack, Discord, Ntfy or Pushover.
- `name` (String)
